Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in valorizing natural minerals into quenched SiO₂ anodes, using rapid quenching to create defective, metastable structures that overcome SiO₂'s poor conductivity and lithiation inertness. This enables durable high-capacity lithium storage from cheap, abundant natural precursors, offering a scalable, sustainable route to high-performance battery anodes and turning low-value minerals into valuable energy materials.

item.title: Dynamic Li+/Na+-Exchanging Interphase Stabilizes High-Voltage Ni-Rich Cathodes for 557 Wh kg–1 Lithium Batteries
item.description:
واسط تبادل Li+/Na+ از پوشش NZSP روی NCM811، پایداری کاتد در ولتاژ بالا را بهبود داده و پاکت‌سل 4 Ah را به 557 Wh kg–1 می‌رساند.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a Na+-based NZSP coating that dynamically undergoes Li+/Na+ exchange during cycling, forming a fast Li+ conductor while incorporating Na+ into the NCM811 lattice as pillar support. This couples interfacial protection with bulk lattice reinforcement, suppressing parasitic reactions and chemo-mechanical degradation. It enables 4.7 V stability and a 557 Wh kg–1 pouch cell, advancing high-energy Ni-rich lithium batteries.
